content: ESA - Chang'e 1 - new mission to Moon lifts off Science & Exploration Chang'e 1 - new mission to Moon lifts off 24/10/2007 13211 views 12 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / SMART-1 A bold new mission to the Moon was launched today by the Chinese National Space Administration (CNSA). Chang’e 1 blasted off from the Xichang Satellite Launch Centre, Sichuan, atop a Long March 3A rocket. Chang’e 1 represents the first step in the Chinese ambition to land robotic explorers on the Moon before 2020. Chang’e 1 has four mission goals to accomplish. The first is to make three-dimensional images of many lunar landforms and outline maps of major lunar geological structures.
